identity_evidence: Dated June 29, 1934; creates the National Labor Relations Board under NIRA title I and Public Resolution 44
outliers_found: administrative order creating an NRA-related board, not a code or agreement approval
also rests on joint resolution of June 19, 1934 (Public Res. 44)
basis: The order creates a labor board, sets its powers and abolishes the National Labor Board. It approves no code or agreement, so it is not of the lot's type.
operative_quote: There is hereby created in connection with the Department of Labor a board to be known as the National Labor Relations Board
notes: Text carries no order number; date and subject agree with claim.

identity_evidence: Bracketed '[No. 7035-D]'; approves Denver, Colorado painting, paperhanging and decorating agreement under NIRA Title I and the Construction Code
basis: The order approves an employer-employee agreement under Title I of NIRA and the Construction Industry code. Any approval under Title I was void after Schechter and the title expired June 16, 1935.
operative_quote:
do hereby adopt and approve the
report, recommendations and findings of the National Industrial Recovery Board
and do hereby order that the said Agreement be and the same hereby is approved
notes: Printed date reads 'May 7, 1936' (claimed 1935-05-07); likely OCR error for 1935, since the number 7035-D agrees. If the date were truly 1936 the bound would still hold, as code approvals could not operate after June 16, 1935.

identity_evidence: Bracketed '[No. 6569]'; printed date 'January 20, 1984' (OCR for 1934); complaints of monopolistic practices to the FTC
outliers_found: administrative/procedural order on routing complaints to the FTC, not a code or agreement approval
partly rests on the Federal Trade Commission Act
basis: The order directs how complaints about monopolistic practices under codes are transferred to the Federal Trade Commission. It approves no code or agreement.
operative_quote:
such complaint shall be transferred to the Federal Trade Commission
by such agency upon request of the complainant

identity_evidence: Bracketed '[No. 6337]'; 'October 14, 1983' (OCR for 1933); rules under section 10(a) and delegation under 2(b)
outliers_found: rules and regulations and delegation of authority, not a code or agreement approval
basis: The order prescribes rules against false claims of code compliance and misuse of NRA emblems and delegates rule-making to the Administrator. It approves no code or agreement.
operative_quote:
No one shall falsely represent himself to be discharging the obligations or
complying with the provisions of the President’s Reemployment Agreement

identity_evidence: Continues the National Labor Board created August 5, 1933 and lists its powers; subject agrees with claimed title
outliers_found: administrative order on a NRA labor board's powers and procedure, not a code or agreement approval
basis: The order continues the National Labor Board and defines its mediation, local board and rule-making powers. It approves no code or agreement.
operative_quote: The National Labor Board, created on August 5, 1933, to "pass promptly on any case of hardship or dispute
notes: Text has no number, signature or date lines (appears truncated after paragraph 2(d)); identity rests on subject match.

identity_evidence: Dated 'Mar. 1, 1935'; approves agreement for painting, paperhanging and decorating employers and employees in Manhattan, Richmond and the Bronx
basis: The order approves, in part (Manhattan and the Bronx only), an agreement under NIRA Title I and the Construction Code. Such an approval could not operate after June 16, 1935.
operative_quote: the said Agreement be and the same hereby is approved insofar as it applies to the operations of Painting, Paperhanging and Decorating Division in the Boroughs of Manhattan and the Bronx
notes: Text has no number; date and subject agree. Approval is partial (Richmond not approved); not a listed outlier.

outliers_found: procedural/delegation order for section 3(e) import complaints, not a code or agreement approval
